headline: U.S. Regulator Says 24/7 Trading is Great for Crypto, May Not be Fit for Other Sectors
title: U.S. Regulator Says 24/7 Trading is Great for Crypto, May Not be Fit for Other Sectors
summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has issued an advisory to the derivatives industry, stating that 24/7 trading is a fit for crypto firms but may not be suitable for other derivatives platforms.
conteudo_blog:
The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has issued an advisory to the derivatives industry, stating that 24/7 trading is a fit for crypto firms but may not be suitable for other derivatives platforms. This announcement comes on the same day that the CFTC allowed crypto firms to get into 24/7 perpetual futures contracts.

## The Scenario
The CFTC's advisory is part of a broader trend towards 24-hour, no-days-off markets. The agency is concerned about the potential for market abuse in less-observed, off-peak activity, and it has urged firms to implement additional compliance measures to address these risks.

## Direct Quote
> "Because of inherent differences between underlying markets, switching to 24/7 trading and clearing may not currently be suitable for all asset classes." — **U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission**

## BBN Insight
The CFTC's decision to allow 24/7 perpetual futures contracts for crypto firms is a significant development in the industry. It marks a growing divide between traditional firms and new entrants in the derivatives market.

## The Scenario
The geopolitical context surrounding the Ukrainian-Russian conflict has led to a significant escalation in attacks on Russian energy infrastructure. The targeting of refineries and export terminals has severely impacted Russia's ability to produce and export oil products, particularly diesel and aviation fuel.
